# Vendored UCL

This directory contains UCL 1.03 by Markus F. X. J. Oberhumer, sourced from
the upstream UCL 1.03 release carried by `ucl-sys` 0.1.1.

UCL is licensed under GPL version 2 or, at your option, any later version.
The complete upstream license is in `COPYING`.

ShannonsPrism compiles the portable C implementations of NRV2B, NRV2D and
NRV2E directly from `src/`; architecture-specific assembly is not used.
